# dt-ui

> Lightweight, copy-based Vue 3 components for the DT ecosystem. CLI-driven, token-driven, dark-mode-ready.

The full documentation as a single file: [llms-full.txt](https://ui.dthub.uz/llms-full.txt)

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://ui.dthub.uz/docs/home.md): dt-ui is a copy-based Vue 3 component registry built for the DT ecosystem. It is **not** a runtime library — you don't `import` from `aet…
- [Getting Started](https://ui.dthub.uz/docs/getting-started.md): dt-ui is a copy-based component registry. You install one npm package for the CLI, then copy individual components into your project. Aft…
- [CLI Reference](https://ui.dthub.uz/docs/cli.md): The `dt-ui` CLI is a thin script around the registry. Every command is deterministic and idempotent — no surprise file rewrites, no globa…
- [Theming & Tokens](https://ui.dthub.uz/docs/theming.md): Every visual decision in dt-ui is a CSS custom property. Override the right token in your own CSS and the entire library responds — no re…
- [Live Demo](https://ui.dthub.uz/docs/demo.md): The site includes a working CRM-style document list at `/demo`. Every element below is a dt-ui component.

## Components — Form

- [DtButton](https://ui.dthub.uz/components/button.md): A clickable button component with four variants, eight sizes, and loading + disabled states. Renders a native `<button>` element and forw…
- [DtInput](https://ui.dthub.uz/components/input.md): Text input with two visual variants, four sizes, validation states (error / success), top or floating label, optional clear button, and `…
- [DtSelect](https://ui.dthub.uz/components/select.md): A Reka UI backed select component with DT styling. It keeps the existing compound API (`DtSelect`, `DtSelectTrigger`, `DtSelectContent`, …
- [DtToggle](https://ui.dthub.uz/components/toggle.md): A switch toggle component with 3 sizes (lg/md/sm) and smooth thumb animation. Uses `role="switch"` with `aria-checked` for accessibility.
- [DtCheckbox](https://ui.dthub.uz/components/checkbox.md): A checkbox component with 3 sizes (lg/md/sm), animated checkmark, and label slot. Uses a hidden native `<input type="checkbox">` for acce…
- [DtRadio](https://ui.dthub.uz/components/radio.md): A radio button component with 3 sizes (lg/md/sm), animated selection dot, and label slot. Uses a hidden native `<input type="radio">` for…
